column2: The lost-in-the-middle problem: LLMs fail to use relevant information in the middle of long contexts (positional bias in long-context LLMs).
How the position of relevant passages (lost in the middle, positional bias) and the number of retrieved passages (top-k, context length, noise) affect RAG answer quality.
Adaptive retrieval-augmented generation: deciding when to retrieve (retrieval necessity, self-reflective / corrective RAG).
Automatic RAG evaluation metrics without human annotation (LLM-as-a-judge, faithfulness, answer relevance).
